name: How long does a siding color change project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a siding color change project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a siding color change project depends on the size and complexity of your home, weather conditions, and the chosen method. For an average-sized home, painting existing siding can take anywhere from a few days to a week. If the project involves extensive repairs, new siding installation, or particularly challenging architectural features, it could extend to several weeks. Your contractor can provide a more precise timeline after assessing your property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies by home size, complexity, and method. Painting usually takes a few days to a week. Extensive work can take several weeks.
